speaker: Doctor
text: I understand you have experienced fatigue, flank pain, and fever following recent antibiotic treatment for acute sinusitis. To better understand your condition, could you please describe the specific characteristics of your pain and when it started?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Pyelonephritis

Since your flank pain and fever persist despite treatment for sinusitis, I need to confirm if the pain is specifically localized to your kidneys. Could you describe the exact location of the pain and whether you are experiencing any urinary symptoms like burning, urgency, or changes in urine color?
